content.text: Hybrid Cars BYD hybrid cars are different. Our Super DM Technology paired with futuristic designs creates a collection of striking, instantly recognisable eco-friendly cars. Combining the power of a petrol engine with the sustainability of an electric motor, choose BYD hybrid cars for an efficient, safe and luxurious driving experience. Time for a change? Discover our hybrid models and find a dealership near you today. New to hybrid cars and want to know more? Find all the information you need, from driving experience to plug-in charging and electric range below. Specially designed for our plug-in hybrid cars, our Super DM Technology is unlike any other; an evolution in intelligent hybrid driving. Our models are efficient, combining advanced technology with stylish, ocean-centric designs for a second-to-none driving experience. BYD’s electric hybrid system (EHS) powertrain combines high-speed dual motors with advanced oil-cooling technology for efficiency and power. The ultra-efficient Xiaoyun hybrid engine boosts torque, while a tailor-made version of the Blade Battery advances power capabilities and boosts the overall electric range in BYD’s hybrid cars. Efficient and Powerful Enjoy energy efficiency and low fuel consumption with our advanced hybrid technology. We don’t compromise on performance. BYD’s Seal U DM-i Design can hit 0-62mph in as little as 5.9 seconds, for the thrill of powerful driving with fewer emissions.Enjoy the feeling of pure electric driving, even in a hybrid model. BYD’s hybrid models charge from 30-80% SOC in as little as 35 minutes.* If you’re heading off the beaten track, BYD’s Vehicle-to-Load (V2L) technology transforms your vehicle into a power source. Plug your appliances into your BYD hybrid car for a home away from home in the great outdoors. *Figures based on BYD Seal U DM-I Boost Learn more about hybrid cars Find out more about the advantages of hybrid cars, how long it takes to charge a hybrid car and more with our comprehensive guides. NET ZERO CHARGING RANGE FINANCE GENERAL Hybrid car FAQs Still have questions about hybrid cars? Find out everything you need to know below: How long does it take to charge a hybrid car? A hybrid car has an engine and an electric motor. If you choose a plug-in hybrid, you’ll need to plug it in to charge. The length of time it takes to charge the car will depend on the model you choose. For example, our BYD SEAL U DM-i model features 18kW DC rapid charging, allowing you to charge from 30% to 80% in just 35 minutes. This means you don’t have to worry about waiting for a long period before setting off on your travels. Do hybrid cars need to be plugged in? Yes, unlike HEV (hybrid electric vehicles) that use only regenerative braking to charge, PHEV (plug-in electric vehicles) can·be charged by both regenerative braking and "plugging into" an external charger. You can do this with a home charger, public charging stations when you’re at work or motorway service stations to keep your hybrid car running on both fuel and electricity. Are hybrid cars good for long-distance driving? Hybrid cars are great for driving long distances as they use both an internal combustion engine and a motor. This means when the electric range runs out, you can simply carry on your journey powered by petrol or diesel — rather than having to stop for long periods to charge. Do hybrid cars run on electricity alone? Hybrid cars can run on just electricity for a limited number of miles, which differs depending on the model you choose. The SEAL U DM-i has a full electric range of 46 miles for the Boost version, 53 miles for the Comfort and 78 miles for the Design. Once this has been exceeded, the engine will take over and recharge the battery while driving to keep your State of Charge (SOC) at the set value.
